mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, triggers a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism operates under the assumption that lower interest rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, thereby increasing the present value of future dividends and earnings.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or if the FEDFUNDS series does not exhibit a sustained decline over the 3-month horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, as indicated by UNRATE, signals a weakening labor market that reduces the demand for equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or if the UNRATE series does not exhibit a sharp increase over the 3-month horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in consumer spending, as measured by PAYEMS, triggers a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This mechanism operates under the assumption that higher consumer spending increases corporate profits and equity valuations.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or if the PAYEMS series does not exhibit a surge over the 1-month horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, signals a weakening supply chain that reduces the capacity for corporate growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or if the INDPRO series does not exhibit a contraction over the 2-month horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the GDP deflator, as measured by CPIAUCSL, triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This mechanism operates under the assumption that higher inflation erodes the real value of equity cash flows, thereby reducing their present value.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or if the CPIAUCSL series does not exhibit a sustained increase over the 6-month horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts, as measured by HOUST, triggers a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism operates under the assumption that higher housing activity increases consumer wealth and spending, thereby boosting corporate profits and equity valuations.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or if the HOUST series does not exhibit a sharp increase over the 2-month horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in retail sales, as measured by RSAFS, triggers a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This mechanism operates under the assumption that higher retail sales increase consumer confidence and spending, thereby boosting corporate profits and equity valuations.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or if the RSAFS series does not exhibit a surge over the 1-month horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the GDP deflator, as measured by CPIAUCSL, triggers a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism operates under the assumption that lower inflation increases the real value of equity cash flows, thereby increasing their present value.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or if the CPIAUCSL series does not exhibit a sustained decline over the 3-month horizon.
